statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ b : ℕ, 2≤b → ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k j : ℕ, k≤4*j → 4*j≤3*k → let S := (Finset.range (b^k)).filter (fun n : ℕ => (∀ i < k, (n/b^(i))%b ≤ 1) ∧ ((Finset.range k).filter (fun i => (n/b^(i))%b=1)).card=j); (((S).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n))).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(1+(S.card:ℝ))^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在只许 0、1 的数字中固定恰有 j 个 1，按每一重量层单独取得幂节省。
plain_statement.en: Prove a relative power saving on each binary-digit weight slice between quarter and three-quarter filling.

brief.zh: 母集估计在尾部稀薄的重量层可失效。引入数字计数的第二个 Fourier 变量，并对 j 一致控制系数提取。
brief.en: Introduce a second frequency marking the number of ones and extract each coefficient uniformly.
